map.家庭自查照护等级时，按 7 项日常生活能力（进食、洗漱、转移、如厕、穿衣、外出、: When self-checking care level at home, score dependence on 7 daily-living abilities (eating, washing, transfer, toileting, dressing, going out, medication).

map.算例：多项需协助（合计 8 分）: Example: multiple items need assistance (total 8 points)
map.：总分 7–9 → 『二级（中度）』，需日常部分照护（洗漱/就餐提醒、短时陪护）: : Total 7-9 -> 'level 2 (moderate)', needs partial daily care (washing/meal reminders, short companionship); ≥10 upgrades to level 3 (severe) high-frequency care.

map.照护等级怎么划分？: How is the care level divided?
map.对 7 项能力逐项计分后求和：<7 一级（轻度）、7–9 二级（中度）、≥10: Score the 7 abilities item by item then sum: <7 level 1 (mild), 7-9 level 2 (moderate), ≥10 level 3 (severe). Higher score means stronger dependence and denser care.
map.家庭自查能当正式评估用吗？: Can home self-check serve as formal assessment?
map.不能。本工具仅用于家庭初步判断与沟通，正式长期照护等级须由专业人员按国家统一标准: No. This tool is only for home preliminary judgment and communication; the formal long-term care grade must be certified by professionals per the national unified standard (including medical and functional assessment).
